items.html: And we shall explain the matter of the straps of the Tefillin of the head — how they are drawn from the knot mentioned, and how they join below with the Tefillin of the hand. Know that everything that is in the Tefillin of the head, which is in the head of ZA, exists also in the Tefillin of the hand, which is in the head of Rachel, the Nukva of ZA.
